description: This file implements a plugin system for hijacking HTTP responses, providing RPC-based methods to read, write, and control hijacked connections, including handling of hijacking responses and managing connection deadlines.

classes.name: hijackedResponse
classes.description: Struct holding hijacked connection, buffered read-writer, and read buffer.

classes.name: hijackedConn
classes.description: RPC client wrapper implementing net.Conn interface for hijacked connection.

classes.name: hijackedConnRW
classes.description: RPC client wrapper for read-write operations on hijacked connection.

classes.name: httpResponseWriterRPCClient
classes.description: RPC client for hijacking HTTP responses, providing a Hijack method.

methods.name: HjConnRWRead
methods.description: Reads data from hijacked response buffer via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnRWWrite
methods.description: Writes data to hijacked response buffer via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnRead
methods.description: Reads data from hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnWrite
methods.description: Writes data to hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnSetDeadline
methods.description: Sets deadline for hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnSetReadDeadline
methods.description: Sets read deadline for hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HjConnSetWriteDeadline
methods.description: Sets write deadline for hijacked connection via RPC.

methods.name: HijackResponse
methods.description: Performs hijacking of HTTP response, establishing RPC hijacked response state.

methods.name: Hijack
methods.description: RPC method to hijack an HTTP response, returning net.Conn and buffered ReadWriter.
